name: Buy an OTC crypto trust trading at a 5%+ discount to its coin NAV, short $1 of the coin perp per $1 of trust; exit when the discount is inside 2.5% or at the trust's exchange listing
thesis: Holders of OTC crypto trusts cannot redeem, so sellers who need out accept a discount, and the discount closes when the trust lists as an ETF (creations and redemptions open) or simply mean-reverts. The daily rule (8 pre-committed variants x 2 hedges; chosen on 2019-09..2024-12 by in-sample Sharpe, tested once on 2025-01-02..2026-10-09) picked 'discount <= -5%, any trust, dollar hedge': +16.9% a year over the savings rate in sample and +20.8% a year out of sample (calendar, on capital; NW t 1.80, rank 1 of 8, deflated Sharpe 0.93, Benjamini-Hochberg survivor with the 10% variant). The classic version (GBTC filed 2021-10-19 at -18.3%, trough -48.7%, converted 2024-01-11 at -1.3%: +17.8% excess on capital; ETHE filed 2023-10-02 at -31.8%: +43.1%) had $100M+ of capacity. It is a standby, not a go: after the SEC's generic listing standards (2025-09-17) new trusts traded at premiums (GSOL +98%, GLNK +100% at filing), the entry rule chosen on GBTC/ETHE (discount >= 30% with a filing) never triggered, and the out-of-sample dollars came from thin OTC names, most of the gains from ZCSH (+$0.88M of +$1.15M gross gains at an ADV-limited size), which listed on 2026-08-25.
mechanism: Non-redeemable wrapper + forced or impatient sellers (OTC trusts accumulated through private placements; holders who cannot use them as collateral or need liquidity). Convergence arrives through the conversion catalyst (19b-4/S-1/S-3, generic listing standards, 8-A12B, first exchange day) or through mean reversion of a thin OTC quote. The dollar hedge (short $1 of the coin perp per $1 of trust, rebalanced daily) removes the directional short the NAV hedge carries while the discount persists.
legs: each day at the US close: for every single-coin OTC trust with a coin-per-share anchor (10-Q/10-K XBRL, carried by the sponsor fee), compute NAV = coin per share x Binance price at 16:00 New York
buy the trust at the close when its discount is <= -5% (OTC broker; OTCQX/OTCQB quotes); size at <= 10% of its 60-day dollar volume over 5 days
short the coin's USD-M perp for the same dollar amount (margin 1/3), rebalance daily to $1 per $1
exit when the discount is above -2.5% or on the trust's first exchange trading day
kill_criteria: a held position more than 12 months without a public conversion filing (the ETCG trap: held since 2021 under this rule, -$0.86M marked at capacity in the test)
trailing 12-month realised excess over the savings rate negative across closed trades
a trust's conversion filing withdrawn or the generic listing standards rescinded
fewer than 3 trades in a 12-month window (dormant)
risks: capacity: today's OTC discounts are LTCN -4.8% ($0.6M ADV), BCHG -4.6% ($0.4M), ETCG -36.9% ($0.1M, no filing); 10% of 5 days' volume is $0.06-0.30M per trust
thin OTC quotes: costs assumed at max(half the Abdi-Ranaldo spread, 1% per side) under $1M ADV; real quotes can be wider
no catalyst: ETCG has traded at -30% to -50% for years without converting
the test period's dollars are concentrated: at an ADV-limited size the chosen rule made +$0.29M in total, ZCSH +$0.88M and LTCN +$0.19M against ETCG -$0.86M
sponsor risk: fee changes, spin-off distributions (the 2024 Mini Trusts moved 10% of GBTC/ETHE coin), custody
a coin rally or crash moves the dollar-hedged P&L by the coin factor times the discount change

evidence.notes: research/2026-10-10/nav_wrappers/tables.md A1-A7; analysis.json trusts.rules_dollar_hedge (choose_then_test, late_entry), trusts.rule_dollars_test, trusts.events, trusts.verification (NAV check vs sponsor NAV: median 0.03-0.44% per trust); scripts/nav_wrappers.py

quotes.note: standby: out of sample 2025-01-02..2026-10-09 the chosen rule made +20.8% a year over the savings rate on calendar capital (t 1.80) and +$164k a year at an ADV-limited size (37 trades, mean +3.9% excess per trade, 86% positive), most of it from ZCSH, now listed. Late entry keeps 77% (1 day) and 52% (1 week). On 2026-10-09 no trust with a pending filing is at the -5% trigger (LTCN -4.8%, BCHG -4.6%); the rule as tested would hold only ETCG (-36.9%, no filing), which the 12-month kill criterion excludes. Recheck weekly.
